title: [Request] Support sambanova.ai Provider
body:
### 🥰 Feature Description

Add sambanova.ai Provider in AI Provider

### 🧐 Proposed Solution

It is similar to Groq. It offers fast LLM models and was the first to support the DS-R1-670B model. Its API is compatible with OpenAI's standards.

### 📝 Additional Information

_No response_
